brief: A small paper goods shop called Fern & Fold that sells handmade notebooks and planners. Calm, crafted, a little botanical. For people who love slow mornings.

directions.name: Pressed Meadow Line
directions.idea: A single continuous line forms a delicate fern leaf interwoven with folded paper pages.
directions.prompt: A minimalist vector logo featuring a single line art fern frond tucked into a folded notebook corner, clean ivory background, elegant line work, flat vector graphic design, isolated.

directions.name: Heritage Woodblock Stamp
directions.idea: A carved linocut emblem depicting a coiled fern frond framing an open hand-bound book.
directions.prompt: A vintage woodcut emblem logo of an unfurling fern frond curving over an open planner, textured block print style, dark olive green on raw parchment background, craft aesthetic, vector.

directions.name: Geometric Foliate Fold
directions.idea: Abstract angular paper folds create a stylized geometric fern leaf structure.
directions.prompt: A modern geometric logo composed of folded paper triangles forming an abstract fern leaf, clean sharp lines, soft sage green and cream tones, minimal vector graphic, white background.

directions.name: Morning Light Wash
directions.idea: A soft watercolor silhouette of a fern frond gently brushing against open journal pages.
directions.prompt: An organic botanical logo featuring a soft watercolor fern frond shadow casting onto an open notebook page silhouette, gentle terracotta and sage palette, delicate atmospheric style, vector design.

directions.name: Midcentury Leaf Motifs
directions.idea: Flat stylized botanical shapes and folded ribbon forms arranged in a retro badge.
directions.prompt: A mid-century modern logo badge with flat graphic fern leaves and folded paper ribbon motifs, muted mustard and forest green colors, simple iconic shapes, clean retro emblem, white background.

directions.name: Serif Foliage Crest
directions.idea: Interlocking letters F and F encircled by delicate hand-drawn fern tendrils.
directions.prompt: An elegant serif monogram logo featuring intertwined letters F and F surrounded by a thin circular fern vine, refined dark green and gold metallic foil style, luxury paper craft brand emblem.
